label: Amapiano Dance Championship: Gugulethu United We Stand Dancers
review: The script was far too dense (78%), with back-to-back lines talking over vocal breaks, duplicate lines in the intro and middle sections, and a hallucinated knee-pulse line at 137s where the dancers are actually upright kicking. Dropping redundant lines and tightening key transitions lets the Amapiano log drum and vocal cues breathe while clarifying the footwork and heist staging. Fixed a hallucinated squat at 119s (they are upright hopping and kicking to the chants, while the wide-stance knee-knock squat actually hits at 137s) and added the center leader standing tall above the final floor freeze at 162s. Tightened callouts, fixed the late huddle timing at 80.5s, and dropped redundant lines at 42.5s and 130.5s so the music can breathe.
signature: Piano Heist theatrical framing with masks and props: whole body posture, hands holding signs, masks, and loot bag
Synchronized deep squat drops and level changes: legs, hips, and knees dropping sharply toward the floor
Wide-stance bent-knee rapid legwork: knees, hips, and ankles with torso pitched forward

sections.label: Theatrical Intro (Piano Heist)
sections.group: Narrative mime and staged entrances, transitioning into a unified ready stance.

sections.label: Cluster & Wide-Stance Groove
sections.group: Unison group groove with the front-center dancer highlighted in the middle.

sections.label: Lighting Shift & Travelling Groove
sections.group: Main group in unison with brief subgroup/soloist accents in the center.

sections.label: Climax Footwork & Floor Freeze
sections.group: Unison climax and synchronized floor drop.

lines.text: Amapiano theatre: two dancers walk in from opposite wings, signs held high.
Walking inward to meet at center, holding signs reading Piano Heist overhead.
Two masked dancers in red jumpsuits stalk in from the wings.
Sign-holders flank the stage as one dancer struts forward, briefcase in hand.
Far right drops into a lookout crouch while others tilt masked heads.
Briefcase down, masks pushed up—they drop into a wide crouch!
Deep squat drop, springing up with wide arm extensions!
Double-bounce squat, springing into cross-body kicks!
Wide-stance bounce circling one arm high, then hop-flicking the right leg.
Huddling tight, they hurdle-leap wide and drop down!
Drop to one knee, then split into clusters, hunching with bouncing knees.
Spreading wide, hinged forward with hands on thighs, torsos bounce sharply.
Upright on the chants, feet shuffle crisp and fast as fists pump down.
Stage floods magenta; in wide stances, they lean and pump elbows.
Wide-stance side steps, flinging arms open then punching one hand high.
Drop to touch the floor, then snap into a wide stance, right arms reaching out!
Bouncing through upright footwork, they drop wide, pumping one knee in!
Drop low into right lunges, then bounce stepping side-to-side.
Bouncy heel-tap footwork across the stage, center dancer folding low.
Bouncing on one leg, they drive sharp knee lifts and low kicks!
Arms punch high, then all crash to hands and knees!
